name: Abimelech
description: King living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: God came to Abimelech in a dream: Behold, thou art but a dead man, for the woman is a man's wife. Adultery was sin in Genesis, way before Exodus 20:14; the Most High said, I withheld thee from sinning against me.
Abimelech called it what it is: a great sin. Adultery is one of the weightier matters; there is no animal sacrifice that atones for it.
Behind the scenes the Lord had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech because of Sarah; when Abraham prayed, God healed them.
Abraham reproved Abimelech over a well his servants had taken violently, and they made a covenant; the seven ewe lambs stood as a witness that Abraham digged the well.
